_readme: Motives for the 39 premade slots (world-slots.json at d69115c). Keyed by slot because non-story slots get random names. 'motive' is for authors and the online/local model prompt only, never shown. 'aside' is one speech line the cat may say unprompted in a meeting or presence scene, with no tokens and no numbers. 'gossip' is how other cats talk about them, with {name} = this cat. Wants stay flavour only (Director ruling): nothing here creates a mechanic, reward or promise. Secrets in loners.md are never stated; lines only hint. Unnamed slots are never named in another cat's line, only by role. Sources: world-gen-spec.md slot table, world-and-prides.md, loners.md.

hc01.motive: Keep Highcrag's order and lineage unbroken, and keep the truth about the fallen cub buried.
hc01.aside: "The crag remembers every cat who ever stood on it. Be careful what it remembers about you."
hc01.gossip: They say {name} has never once been seen to hurry, not even when the river rose.

hc02.motive: Earn his mother's place and outrun the day the fallen cub is spoken of.
hc02.aside: "Everyone on the crag is waiting for me to fail at something. I don't plan to give them the pleasure."
hc02.gossip: {name} trains harder than anyone on the crag, as if something's chasing him.

hc03.motive: Stand behind the leader and keep the crag fed with big game; wants the young ones taught to wait.
hc03.aside: "A good hunter waits. Most young cats never learn that, and most of them stay hungry."
hc03.gossip: {name} doesn't say much, but the crag eats well because of him.

hc04.motive: Belong on the crag completely, though he has always felt like the cat who doesn't quite fit.
hc04.aside: "Sometimes the old cats look at me as if they're trying to remember something."
hc04.gossip: {name} was brought up on the crag, but no one ever tells the same story about where he came from.

hc05.motive: Be the best stalker on the crag and be trusted with the hunts that matter.
hc05.aside: "Snow tells you everything if you're patient enough to read it."
hc05.gossip: If there's a hare on the high meadow, {name} has already found it.

hc06.motive: Keep her cubs safe and the dens peaceful; wants the arguments kept away from the nursery.
hc06.aside: "Lower your voice near the dens, please. The little ones have only just gone to sleep."
hc06.gossip: {name} could calm a storm if it came near the cubs.

hc07.motive: Guard the crag and its law. Still carries her daughter's leaving, and won't show it.
hc07.aside: "I've guarded this crag a long time. I know the look of a cat who's thinking about leaving it."
hc07.gossip: {name} hasn't been the same since her daughter left, though she'd bite anyone who said so.

hc08.motive: Keep every name in the recitation; dreads a name being lost.
hc08.aside: "Every name I recite was a cat once. When I'm gone, I hope someone keeps them."
hc08.gossip: {name} knows every name back to the first cats on the crag, and a few the crag would rather forget.

hc09.motive: Prove he's grown, and get out from under being the leader's youngest.
hc09.aside: "I'll be hunting big game soon. Everyone keeps saying 'soon'."
hc09.gossip: {name} follows the hunters everywhere and thinks nobody notices.

hc10.motive: Play, explore and find out what's past the dens.
hc10.aside: "Are you from far away? How far? Further than the ledge?"
hc10.gossip: {name} is always one paw further from the den than she's allowed.

hc11.motive: Stay warm and near his mother; everything is new.
hc11.aside: The cub squeaks and hides behind the nearest grown cat.
hc11.gossip: {name} is the newest life on the crag.

bf01.motive: Hold Bonefield by strength and keep every challenger afraid; watches for weakness, including his own.
bf01.aside: "Three cats have tried to take this field from me. Look around. You don't see any of them."
bf01.gossip: {name} won the field by challenge and has held it through three. Nobody talks about how he'll lose it.

bf02.motive: Rise in rank. Torn between what he owes the field and what he once wanted at the ford.
bf02.aside: "In Bonefield you take what you want or you go without. I'm still deciding what I want."
bf02.gossip: {name} used to go down to the ford a lot. He doesn't any more.

bf03.motive: Bring down the biggest prey in the Vale and be respected for it.
bf03.aside: "Anyone can kill a hare. Come and find me when you've faced a bison."
bf03.gossip: {name} has more kills than scars, and in Bonefield that's rare.

bf04.motive: Keep her cubs strong enough to survive Bonefield, and keep her mate's rule steady.
bf04.aside: "My cubs will be fighters. They'll have to be."
bf04.gossip: {name} hunts at her mate's side and watches his back when he's not looking.

bf05.motive: Feed her cub and earn rank through clean kills, not noise.
bf05.aside: "Quick and clean. The prey doesn't suffer, and neither do I."
bf05.gossip: {name} kills faster than anyone in the field and makes less fuss about it.

bf06.motive: Find a place in a pride that only listens to the loud; she notices what others miss.
bf06.aside: "Everyone in the field shouts. I'd rather listen to what the grass says."
bf06.gossip: {name} reads the trails better than cats twice her age, not that the field cares.

bf07.motive: Survive and stay useful. Carries the shame of bowing without a fight and the memory of the leader he once guarded.
bf07.aside: "I've guarded two leaders. You learn which fights are worth having. I hope."
bf07.gossip: {name} bowed to the new leader without a fight. Half the field respects him for it and half never will.

bf08.motive: Win her father's approval and her first challenge.
bf08.aside: "I could beat you. Probably. Want to find out?"
bf08.gossip: {name} is her father's daughter, and she wants everyone to know it.

bf09.aside: The cub growls a tiny growl and pounces on your tail.
bf09.gossip: {name} has already started picking fights with the grass.

bf10.aside: The cub watches you with round eyes from between her mother's paws.
bf10.gossip: {name} is the youngest in the field.

mw01.motive: Hold the broken pride together; carries the leadership no one else would take, and the grief of the Breaking.
mw01.aside: "We were more, once. The fog keeps what it is given. It gave nothing back."
mw01.gossip: {name} took the lead after the Breaking because nobody else would. She hasn't rested since.

mw02.motive: Protect his mate and cub; one of the few toms left after the ice.
mw02.aside: "I came out of the ice. Plenty of others didn't. So I keep watch."
mw02.gossip: {name} still won't go near the Mere.

mw03.motive: Prove a young, scarred tom is still worth something to a pride that lost its strongest.
mw03.aside: "The leg's fine. Slower than it was, that's all. I can still walk all night."
mw03.gossip: {name} was barely grown when the ice broke. He hasn't stopped walking since.

mw04.motive: Keep her family fed and hidden; trusts very few.
mw04.aside: "You don't know where our dens are. Let's keep it that way."
mw04.gossip: {name} could track a goose through fog by its heartbeat, they say.

mw05.motive: Keep the old trails alive and teach them before more are lost.
mw05.aside: "The safe paths through the marsh used to be common knowledge. Now only a few of us remember."
mw05.gossip: {name} walks the old trails every season so the pride won't forget them.

mw06.motive: Want a pride that laughs again; gentle, hopeful, a little lonely.
mw06.aside: "It's been quiet in the Mistwood a long time. It's nice to hear a new voice."
mw06.gossip: {name} still talks to everyone who passes, even after everything.

mw07.motive: Guard what Mistwood knows and nurse it through; old, half-blind, unhurried.
mw07.aside: "I've seen more winters than you have teeth. Sit. Tell me what you're looking for."
mw07.gossip: {name} is older than anyone in the Mistwood, and she knows things the fog doesn't.

mw08.motive: Live up to a father who drowned leading the pride; afraid of the ice and of being him.
mw08.aside: "Everyone says I'll lead one day. My father led, and look where it took him."
mw08.gossip: {name} is the drowned leader's son, and the whole pride watches him for signs of it.

mw09.motive: Be a cub in a pride that needs her to be hope.
mw09.aside: The cub peeks out of the reeds at you, then vanishes again.
mw09.gossip: {name} is the first cub born in the Mistwood since the Breaking.

ln01.motive: Endure exile with dignity; wants the truth kept from shaming the crag, and to be judged fairly by someone.
ln01.aside: "I knew every name on the crag once. Now no one says mine. That's the way of it."
ln01.gossip: {name} was the crag's counselor until the leader drove him out. He went without a word.

ln02.motive: Find out why the cat she left for never came, and find somewhere she belongs.
ln02.aside: "I left for someone. He hasn't come. I'm starting to wonder what I'm waiting for."
ln02.gossip: {name} left the crag on the first warm night of summer and still sits by the Split Rock some evenings.

ln03.motive: Get back what Scarjaw took from him; uses anyone to get close enough for a second chance.
ln03.aside: "Everyone looks at the cheek. Nobody asks what I almost did before I got it."
ln03.gossip: {name} challenged the Bonefield leader and nearly won. Nearly.

ln04.motive: Be done with Bonefield's noise; protects cubs fiercely and quietly.
ln04.aside: "I got tired of the noise. That's all you need to know about why I left."
ln04.gossip: {name} walked out of Bonefield one season and never said why.

ln05.motive: See what lies beyond the edge of the Vale and never be stuck anywhere.
ln05.aside: "Have you ever gone north past the Ice Wall? No? You should. Everyone should."
ln05.gossip: {name} comes and goes like weather. You'll see him when the hunting's thin.

ln06.motive: Live out her days with some warmth; too proud to ask to be carried home.
ln06.aside: "Sit with an old cat a while. I don't get much company out here."
ln06.gossip: Mistwood thinks {name} is dead. She'd rather they kept thinking it than saw her like this.

ln07.motive: Carry what he did without excuses; wants nothing from anyone except to be left alone.
ln07.aside: "I did what they say I did. Don't ask me why."
ln07.gossip: {name} was driven out of the Mistwood for stealing from the starving. He's never denied it.

ln08.motive: Find the family she lost; can't stop searching the river.
ln08.aside: "Have you seen any cubs along the river? Any at all? I keep looking."
ln08.gossip: {name} walks the river every day, looking for something the river won't give back.

ln09.motive: Find his way back to Mistwood, and dreads facing those who were on the ice.
ln09.aside: "Do you know where the Mistwood dens are now? They moved. I can't find the scent."
ln09.gossip: {name} has been looking for the Mistwood ever since the ice. They moved, and he can't find them.
